examples.title: Machine Learning Engineer
examples.description: Build and deploy machine-learning services. Candidates must have 1-2 years of relevant ML experience and strong Python skills.
examples.human_rationale: Every eligible value is below five years.
examples.important_evidence: 1-2 years of relevant ML experience

examples.title: Software Engineer, AI Platform
examples.description: Develop reliable AI platform services. Requires 2+ years of software engineering experience and production Python knowledge.
examples.human_rationale: The required minimum is below five years.
examples.important_evidence: 2+ years of software engineering experience

examples.title: ML Engineer
examples.description: Own production model pipelines and monitoring. You need 4+ years building production ML systems.
examples.human_rationale: A candidate with four years is eligible.
examples.important_evidence: 4+ years building production ML systems

examples.title: Senior ML Engineer
examples.description: Lead model deployment projects. Five or more years of relevant professional experience is required.
examples.human_rationale: The required minimum is five years.
examples.important_evidence: Five or more years of relevant professional experience is required

examples.title: Applied AI Engineer
examples.description: Create retrieval and evaluation systems. We require 3-5 years of experience in applied machine learning.
examples.human_rationale: The inclusive range permits candidates with three or four years.
examples.important_evidence: 3-5 years of experience

examples.title: Senior AI Engineer
examples.description: Design and operate large-scale AI services. Applicants must bring 5-7 years of professional engineering experience.
examples.human_rationale: No value below five satisfies the required range.
examples.important_evidence: 5-7 years of professional engineering experience

examples.title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer
examples.description: Lead delivery across multiple ML services. At least 7 years total engineering experience is required, including 3 years in ML.
examples.human_rationale: The total required professional experience is at least seven years.
examples.important_evidence: At least 7 years total engineering experience

examples.title: Machine Learning Engineer
examples.description: Build ranking models and APIs. Two years of relevant experience is required; five years is preferred.
examples.human_rationale: A preferred qualification does not override the lower required minimum.
examples.important_evidence: Two years of relevant experience is required

examples.title: AI Platform Engineer
examples.description: Develop model-serving infrastructure. Four years of engineering experience is required; 6+ years is strongly preferred.
examples.human_rationale: A four-year candidate satisfies the requirement despite the preference.
examples.important_evidence: Four years of engineering experience is required

examples.title: Data Scientist
examples.description: Train forecasting and language models. Eligibility is a bachelor's degree plus 3 years of experience, or a master's degree plus 1 year.
examples.human_rationale: Both explicit alternative paths permit fewer than five years.
examples.important_evidence: a master's degree plus 1 year

examples.title: Research Scientist
examples.description: Research efficient foundation models. Candidates need 5+ years of industry experience, or a PhD in a relevant field with no industry-experience minimum.
examples.human_rationale: At least one explicit eligibility path permits fewer than five years.
examples.important_evidence: a PhD in a relevant field with no industry-experience minimum

examples.title: Graduate AI Engineer
examples.description: Join a mentored team building AI features. New graduates and candidates with internship experience are welcome.
examples.human_rationale: The role explicitly welcomes early-career candidates.
examples.important_evidence: New graduates and candidates with internship experience are welcome

examples.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
examples.description: Build and maintain recommendation models. The role requires 3+ years of relevant professional experience.
examples.human_rationale: The description minimum controls; the senior title alone does not exclude.
examples.important_evidence: requires 3+ years of relevant professional experience

examples.title: Junior AI Engineer
examples.description: Own architecture for a critical model platform. Applicants must have 6+ years of professional software engineering experience.
examples.human_rationale: The description minimum controls; a junior title does not include.
examples.important_evidence: 6+ years of professional software engineering experience

examples.title: ML Software Engineer
examples.description: The qualifications section requires 3+ years of engineering experience. A later mandatory requirements section says candidates must have 8+ years of professional experience.
examples.human_rationale: Conflicting mandatory minimums require manual review.
examples.important_evidence: requires 3+ years of engineering experience

examples.title: Software Engineer, AI
examples.description: Own one bounded AI service with design guidance and regular mentoring. No minimum years of experience are stated.
examples.human_rationale: The described scope is clearly compatible with early-career execution.
examples.important_evidence: with design guidance and regular mentoring

examples.title: Principal AI Architect
examples.description: Set organization-wide AI architecture, manage multiple engineering teams, and own long-range technical strategy. No years requirement is stated.
examples.human_rationale: Strong senior scope exists, but no explicit eligibility boundary proves exclusion.
examples.important_evidence: Set organization-wide AI architecture

examples.title: AI Engineer
examples.description: Build scalable AI systems and collaborate with product teams. The posting contains no years, level, ownership boundary, or early-career language.
examples.human_rationale: There is insufficient seniority evidence.
examples.important_evidence: Build scalable AI systems

examples.title: Machine Learning Engineer
examples.description: Our company has 10 years of ML experience and serves global customers. Build production models with the team; no candidate experience requirement is provided.
examples.human_rationale: The number describes the company, not candidate eligibility.
examples.important_evidence: Our company has 10 years of ML experience

examples.title: Applied Scientist
examples.description: Develop and evaluate language models. Applicants may have up to 5 years of relevant professional experience.
examples.human_rationale: The stated range permits candidates below five years.
examples.important_evidence: up to 5 years of relevant professional experience
